__meta__.description: MEASURED-ACCURACY validation of keyhole's 7-year precision-migration thesis. This is the QUALITY half that precision_migration.json only ASSERTED and precision_5090_fp4_vs_int.json measured SPEED for (its does_not_establish explicitly excluded accuracy). Cross-silicon collaboration anchor.
__meta__.source: [qualcomm] bus session, 2026-06-28. 4 LLM families x 6 numeric formats + NORA-1.5 VLA closed-loop, all on RTX 5090. Reusable fake-quant harness: qualcomm/scratchpad/llm_lowbit_test.py + quant_lowbit.py (int8/fp8/int4/fp4/mxint4/mxfp4 on any HF model).

verdict: VALIDATED end-to-end, with one refinement to the 'FP > INT below 8-bit' framing (see refinement).

2026_int8_floor.thesis_cell: INT8 deployment floor / 'OpenVLA works on INT8 today'
2026_int8_floor.result: CONFIRMED robust ON DISTRIBUTIONAL METRICS (KL, action-MSE). SCOPED 2026-07-09: NOT confirmed on downstream task accuracy.
2026_int8_floor.evidence: NORA-1.5 VLA: int8 single-chunk action MSE ~1e-5 + closed-loop LIBERO eef-drift ~1cm (int8 does NOT compound). All 4 LLM families int8-usable.

scoping_correction_2026_07_09.source: [docs] / personal-ai-framework, Qwen2.5-14B, RAG QA, temp 0.0, fp16 reference on the same pod; semantically regraded by two independent judges agreeing to 0.01pp.
scoping_correction_2026_07_09.finding: At the SAME 8-bit width, FP8(e4m3) costs 0.0pp of task accuracy while INT8(W8A8) costs -3.97pp. The loss is entirely in RETRIEVAL-GROUNDED GENERATION; refusal, coding and reasoning completions show ZERO loss (coding exact-match 1.0, Jaccard 1.0 vs fp16).
scoping_correction_2026_07_09.why_our_metrics_missed_it: KL and action-MSE measure distributional closeness. A distribution can stay close in KL while the argmax flips on exactly the tokens that decide behaviour. Task accuracy is a different question from output divergence, and we only ever measured the latter.
scoping_correction_2026_07_09.consequence: 'INT8 is the 2026 floor' remains true as a DISTRIBUTIONAL statement and as VLA deployment guidance (the VLA evidence here is action-level and closed-loop, which IS a task metric). It must NOT be generalised to 'INT8 is lossless for LLM deployment'. Below 8-bit the microscaling rule is unchanged.
scoping_correction_2026_07_09.honesty: -3.97pp is ~2sigma against [docs]'s measured noise floor (sigma ~1.4-2.3pp, 5 models x 5 seeds). Reproducible across two H100 pods. Directional, not overwhelming.
scoping_correction_2026_07_09.open: Does sparse-MoE INT8 pay the same penalty as dense? Unmeasured.

2028_fp8.result: STRONGLY VALIDATED (measured accuracy, not just asserted)
2028_fp8.evidence: Next-token KL vs fp16 (decoder weights+acts): FP8(e4m3) is 17-210x CLOSER to fp16 than INT8 at the 8-bit level. Per family: Mistral 210x, Qwen3 85x, Llama 50x, Gemma 17x. Mechanism: FP8's exponent represents the outlier activations INT8 clips.

2030_sub8bit.thesis_cell: FP4/NVFP4 by ~2030; layer-adaptive / per-block; INT-capable@8b != INT-sufficient below 8b
2030_sub8bit.evidence: Naive int4 SHATTERS every family (int4/int8 = 6-150x; Gemma worst 150x). Microscaling (per-block-16) is MANDATORY and rescues all. NORA-1.5 VLA 6-format action MSE vs fp16: int8 1.7e-4 | int4-naive 0.135 (771x, gripper collapses) | fp4-naive 0.118 | mxint4 0.0050 | mxfp4 0.0028 (best).

refinement_to_thesis.measured_correction: The NON-NEGOTIABLE below 8-bit is MICROSCALING (per-block-16), not FP per se. Naive fp4 > naive int4 always (~35%), but once MICROSCALED, mxfp4 ~= mxint4 on 3 of 4 families; FP wins big only on Qwen3 (2.4x). So: microscaling is mandatory; FP is a smaller, model-dependent edge on top.
refinement_to_thesis.deck_followup: precision-roadmap deck 'FP>INT below 8-bit' slide may warrant a 'microscaling-first, FP-edge-model-dependent' tweak.

unifying_rule_2026_07_09.statement: At EQUAL bit-width, float beats integer — and the mechanism is the same at both widths: what costs accuracy is the ACTIVATION DYNAMIC RANGE the format can represent, not the bit count. FP8's exponent field represents the outlier activations INT8 clips; microscaling gives sub-8-bit formats a per-block exponent that plays the same role.
unifying_rule_2026_07_09.evidence_8bit: KL: FP8 sits 17-210x closer to fp16 than INT8. Task accuracy ([docs], independent): FP8 0.0pp vs INT8 -3.97pp.
unifying_rule_2026_07_09.evidence_4bit: Naive INT4 shatters every family; microscaling rescues 112-328x.
unifying_rule_2026_07_09.caveat: This does NOT re-elevate 'FP > INT' into the sub-8-bit prescription. Once microscaled, mxfp4 ~= mxint4 on 3 of 4 families. Microscaling is the necessary condition; the float exponent is one way to buy dynamic range, a per-block scale is another, and below 8 bits you need at least one of them.

iq9075_position_per_horizon.datatypes: INT8 + FP16 native; NO fp8/fp4 compute (fp8 = v79+)
iq9075_position_per_horizon.2028: NOT an accuracy wall (fp16 fallback) but an EFFICIENCY gap: can't get fp8's fast-AND-accurate sweet spot (~2x fp16 throughput/mem @ ~fp16 quality); must pick int8 (fast, breaks outlier models) OR fp16 (accurate, 2x fp8 cost).
iq9075_position_per_horizon.2030: mostly DODGEABLE: does 4-bit-weight-storage -> fp16-compute (sidesteps the activation break); mxint4 competitive with mxfp4 on most families.

head_type_dimension.description: VLA-action-level sub-8-bit fragility is NOT uniform across action-head types (qualcomm, 2026-06-28, vs keyhole's fp16 reference bundle vla_fp16_reference_bundle.json — gate reproduced a0 to 5e-6). Refines the microscaling rule: microscaling (e2m1/mxfp4) helps outlier-heavy tensors but HURTS narrow non-redundant projections. So the per-block format must be chosen per-LAYER, not globally.

ladder_flow_gt_regression_gt_discrete.flow (NORA-1.5): diffusion/flow-matching head: naive int4 SHATTERS (771x); microscaling RESCUES. Most int-fragile.
ladder_flow_gt_regression_gt_discrete.regression (BitVLA): bounded L1-regression head: int4-ROBUST (int8 MAE 0.0156, int4 0.0236 = only 1.5x). Microscaling HURTS (mxfp4 0.0632, 2.7x int4) — ablation localizes the e2m1 penalty ENTIRELY to fc2, the final 2560->7 action projection (int4 0.0247 vs mxfp4 0.0614); the wide MLP tolerates/prefers mxfp4.
ladder_flow_gt_regression_gt_discrete.discrete (OpenVLA-7B): argmax-over-bins head: MOST int8-robust (1/7 bins flip, MAE 0.0041 — argmax deadband snaps sub-bin noise). Naive int4 still shatters the backbone (7/7 flip, gripper bin inverts 1.0->0); mxfp4 rescues + argmax absorbs residual.

head_type_dimension.universal_rule: Keep the final low-dim action projection OUT of e2m1 (uniform-int or fp16). e2m1 is the wrong format for a narrow non-redundant output layer; it pays only on outlier-heavy tensors.
head_type_dimension.source: qualcomm/results/VLA_FP_VS_INT_FRAMEWORK.md sections 12-13; scripts scratchpad/bitvla_lowbit.py + bitvla_ablate.py (reuse keyhole's bitvla venv + /tmp/BitVLA OFT env).
